name: warmfold
description: Compacts an idle session before the prompt cache expires, so the first request after a break is cheap.

idle_minutes.title: Idle minutes
idle_minutes.description: The watcher acts after this many idle minutes.

min_context_tokens.title: Minimum context tokens
min_context_tokens.description: The watcher ignores contexts below this size.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: The action before cache expiry. Auto uses a verified native compaction channel.

ttl_5m_policy.title: 5 minute TTL policy
ttl_5m_policy.description: What to do when the session cache lasts only 5 minutes.

keepalive_hours.title: Keepalive hours
keepalive_hours.description: In keepalive mode, wake the session for at most this many hours.
